description: This file contains the implementation of DialogHelper interface, providing methods to display dialogs within an Android activity, specifically handling exception dialogs by creating AlertDialog instances. It manages dialog creation and display logic, encapsulating dialog handling in a helper class.

classes.name: DialogHelperImpl
classes.description: Implements DialogHelper, providing mechanisms to show dialogs associated with exceptions within an Android activity context, including creating specific alert dialogs based on dialog IDs.

methods.name: showErrorMessageDialog
methods.description: Displays an error message dialog using a string title and an exception.

methods.name: handleOnCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates a dialog based on the given ID and argument bundle, specifically handling exception dialogs.

methods.name: convertExceptionToErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an exception into a user-readable error message string.
